definitions.explanation: a train car or vehicle designated as smoke-free

examples.japanese: {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}の{席|せき}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'd like a seat in the non-smoking car, please.

examples.japanese: この{列車|れっしゃ}は{全車両|ぜんしゃりょう}{禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}です。
examples.english: All cars on this train are non-smoking.

examples.japanese: かつては{喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}と{禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}が{分|わ}かれていたが、{今|いま}ではほとんどの{列車|れっしゃ}が{全面|ぜんめん}{禁煙|きんえん}だ。
examples.english: Trains used to be split between smoking and non-smoking cars, but now almost all trains are entirely smoke-free.

notes:
Composed of {禁煙|きんえん} (no smoking) and {車|しゃ} (car/vehicle). Historically, Japanese trains had separate {喫煙車|きつえんしゃ} (smoking cars) and {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ} (non-smoking cars). As of the 2020s, almost all trains in Japan are entirely non-smoking, making the distinction largely historical. The term is still used when booking Shinkansen seats, as some older reservation systems reference it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}の{指定席|していせき}: reserved seat in a non-smoking car
- {全車|ぜんしゃ}{禁煙|きんえん}: all cars non-smoking
- {禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}を{希望|きぼう}する: to request a non-smoking car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}: smoking car — the opposite, now largely discontinued
- {禁煙|きんえん}{席|せき}: non-smoking seat — used in restaurants and planes
- {禁煙|きんえん}: no smoking — the general concept or policy
